passages.text: Those who are healthy have no need for a physician, but those who are sick do.
passages.note: Feeling unworthy; help is for those who struggle

passages.text: Freely you received, so freely give.
passages.note: Generosity in return for what you were given

passages.text: Aren’t two sparrows sold for an assarion coin? Not one of them falls on the ground apart from your Father’s will, but the very hairs of your head are all numbered. Therefore don’t be afraid. You are of more value than many sparrows.
passages.note: Fear and feeling insignificant; being known and valued

passages.text: Come to me, all you who labor and are heavily burdened, and I will give you rest. Take my yoke upon you, and learn from me, for I am gentle and humble in heart; and you will find rest for your souls. For my yoke is easy, and my burden is light.
passages.note: Exhaustion and heavy burdens; longing for rest
